Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.

One warm task lamp, restrained cyan reflected light. No labels, no gauges with numbers, no status colors, no symbols, no wires joining trays. Center of both trays and the broad upper-left margin remain visually quiet for separately authored test traces. A local simulation metaphor, not a real security experiment.

SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: LOCAL TOY SIMULATION. Now a deliberately small simulation. Publication reaches our dispatcher with an inspection only grant. It is held.
